texts.about_this_item: Beaphar flea and tick collar for dogs from 6 months of age. Kills parasites and protects against re-infestation by fleas and ticks for 6 months. Water-resistant: the dog can be bathed without removing it. Active ingredient: diazinon. Fit the collar loosely around the neck and cut off the excess, allowing for growth; it works only when worn continuously.
texts.feeding_instructions: Fit the collar loosely around the dog's neck and cut off the excess strap, allowing for growth. The collar works only when worn continuously; it is water-resistant, so the dog can be bathed without removing it.
